data.title: Write liquid/BRANDING.md: Y2K aqua design direction (blur, transparency, no hard edges)

data.body:
Review (fresh read of liquid/BRANDING.md against plan acceptance criteria):
- File exists, non-empty, 9 numbered sections mirroring memphis/BRANDING.md structure. PASS
- Palette: 11 named tokens + film/alpha tokens, all hexes present; contrast table computed against the three grounds text sits on, with explicit 'Bloom and Mercury carry language' rule + a transparency caveat for text-over-glass. PASS
- Self-contained: one @import (M PLUS Rounded 1c) as required by the build contract; all other assets are inline SVG data URIs or gradients. No image files, no head <link>s. PASS
- No-straight-lines law: stated in section 1 as rule 1 and enforced in section 5 with radius floor (28px), border ban with inset-rim replacement, curved dividers, mask feathering, and a 'hard gradient stops are edges too' rule. PASS
- Blur gotchas box (3.8): backdrop-root destruction by ancestor filter/opacity, -webkit- prefix, filter-blur containing block for fixed, blur bleed -> overflow: clip, 3-layer backdrop cap, mix-blend-mode isolation, never animate filter values. PASS
- 'What this is not' table distinguishes corporate glassmorphism, Frutiger Aero, vaporwave, Aqua skeuomorphism, neumorphism, Y2K kitsch. PASS
- Section 9 maps to the site's real content (Forrest Almasi / software developer / What's up? / GitHub @malls / Twitter @forrestalmasi / _@forrestalmasi.com) and calls out build-contract specifics: isolation on wrapper, liquid- prefix on SVG ids AND keyframes, no position: fixed, no commas in :is(). PASS

Findings: none blocking. Note the SVG-id-collision hazard documented in section 9 is a build-contract fact not currently recorded in root CLAUDE.md — worth promoting there so future sub-sites inherit it.

Deviation from convention: this session was explicitly instructed not to spawn sub-agents, so plan/impl/review ran in one context rather than three. Recorded for transparency.
